shared_elements: rows or bands of repeated signs/marks
schematic relief figures on a vertical surface
justification: The main possible correspondence is the use of repeated small marks arranged in horizontal rows or bands, but in A these are geometric/pattern-like motifs among animals while in B they read as a central field of inscription-like signs above standing human figures. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by profile animals and abstract motifs, whereas B is dominated by a large text-like panel and upright human/anthropomorphic figures with no comparable animal scheme.
